label: DC Ward 3

county_election_office.name: DC Board of Elections (DCBOE), 1015 Half Street SE

zip_caveats: ZIPs don't follow ward lines, so use this as a starting point only. 20016 (Tenleytown, AU Park, Spring Valley) and 20008 (Cleveland Park, Woodley Park, Van Ness, Forest Hills) are mostly Ward 3, though slivers of 20008 are in Wards 1 and 2. 20007 is split with Ward 2: Georgetown is Ward 2, while Glover Park and points west are Ward 3. 20015 (Chevy Chase DC) is split between Wards 3 and 4, and its commission, ANC 3/4G, crosses the ward line. To be sure, look up your address in the city's ANC locator (https://dcgis.maps.arcgis.com/apps/instant/lookup/index.html?appid=12bb36e8b77a4a8780125e77e990b146): your district code starts with your ward number. Your mailed ballot is printed for your ward. These ZIP lists come from the home ZIPs of this year's candidates (who must live in the district they run for) plus general geography, not from an official ZIP-to-ward table.

find_my_ward.anc_locator_note: The city's ANC locator (official DC GIS map). Enter your address to get your single-member district code. The code starts with your ward number: 1B05 is Ward 1. Codes starting 3/4G or 6/8F sit on a ward line, so check your ballot.

notes: Ward 3 ballot: districtwide races, then Ward 3 Council (one candidate), Ward 3 State Board of Education (two candidates, pick one), your ANC race, and Initiative 86 last. You can vote at any Vote Center in DC, early (Oct 26 to Nov 1, 8:30 AM to 7 PM) or on Election Day (7 AM to 8 PM); you don't have to stay in your ward.
